Let the polygon have \(n\) sides.  
The sum of all interior angles of an \(n\)-sided convex polygon is

\[
180(n-2)^\circ.
\]

Let the one missing interior angle be \(x^\circ\). Since the polygon is convex,

\[
0 < x < 180.
\]

The sum of all but one angle is \(1070^\circ\), so

\[
1070 + x = 180(n-2).
\]

Thus

\[
1070 < 180(n-2) < 1070+180 = 1250.
\]

The only multiple of \(180\) between \(1070\) and \(1250\) is \(1080\). So

\[
180(n-2)=1080.
\]

Divide by \(180\):

\[
n-2=6,
\]

\[
n=8.
\]

The answer is 8.
